Name: Fix Android photo upload crash
Description: Marcus to fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback on Android 14 that occurs when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload. It is the top crasher at ~4% of Android sessions. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Fixed and verified by Wednesday so QA has time before the August 20 release.

Name: Verify Android crash fix on test devices
Description: Sam to confirm Marcus's crash fix on Android 14 test devices once it lands and add it to the regression run.

Name: Build sync API for offline notes list
Description: Elena to build the backend sync API endpoint this sprint. Client sends last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; no merge UI this pass. Elena to have it in review before she is out on the 17th and 18th.

Name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
Description: Marcus to implement the client side: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: open the app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when back online with no data loss. Marcus to write the acceptance criteria into the ticket.

Name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
Description: Sam to finish the test and release pipelines on GitHub Actions (proof of concept for build job already exists), keep the nightly build schedule, and run both GitHub Actions and Jenkins in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Jenkins must stay alive until the parallel week is clean.

Name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
Description: Elena to add per-user rate limiting: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that limit. Also add a metrics counter so it is visible who is hitting the limit. Motivated by an incident where a misbehaving script degraded search for everyone.

Name: Update privacy/consent screen for GDPR compliance
Description: Marcus to update the privacy policy screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, nothing pre-checked (replacing the single pre-checked box). He will get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. This is a launch blocker and must be in the August 20 release.

Name: Write regression tests for payments flow
Description: Sam to write automated regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
